messages:
liz: seeing a spike in apiserver 5xx and lots of controller-manager leader elections in ap-southeast1-az3, started ~09:12 UTC. svc create requests timing out, GPU attaches failing intermittently
ops-bot: [ALERT] apiserver_high_5xx in ap-southeast1 (09:14) — sustained for 3m
samir: can you paste the apiserver logs around the first 5xxs? also any recent compaction or snapshot jobs?
liz: pasting logs, trimmed:
```
E0909 09:12:34.123 apiserver.go:234] watch handler failed: net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)
W0909 09:12:35.456 controller.go:98] leader election lost: failed to renew lease: context deadline exceeded
E0909 09:12:36.789 attach.go:412] attach failed: timeout waiting for device attach (i/o timeout)
```
jules: fwiw we rolled a change to etcd compaction schedule yesterday to reduce snapshot size (moved compaction to every 2h). could be contributing to IO bursts
dena: also seeing NAT gateway SNAT port exhaustion graph in ap-southeast1 at 09:10, conntrack spikes aligned with apiserver 5xxs — controller-manager -> etcd connections might be hitting ephemeral port limits
samir: can you share the conntrack/egress time series?
dena: attaching short dump (trimmed):
```
Conntrack entries: 81920 -> 131072 in 4m
SNAT ports used: 45000/65535 -> 64000/65535
TCP_ESTABLISHED count to etcd endpoints doubled during window
```
liz: interesting — also noticed nvme io_util on etcd hosts jumping to 95% during compaction window, latencies 10-40ms on journal commits
jules: that matches. compaction churn + nvme write spikes -> etcd raft leader stalls -> apiserver watch reconnects -> controller-manager leader flips because renew attempts time out
samir: propose immediate mitigations: 1) pause the aggressive compaction (roll back schedule) 2) add short-lived BGP egress path to another NAT pool if possible 3) reduce GPU attach concurrency on provisioner to lower attach storms
liz: doing 1 now — creating rollback to previous compaction cron (reverting to 6h). redeploy in progress: `kubectl apply -f infra/etcd-compaction-6h.yaml`
ops-bot: [DEPLOY] rollout started for etcd-compaction-config by liz (09:28)
dena: meanwhile I opened a temporary SNAT pool vlan to offload ~20k ports, pushing routes now
jules: for longer-term: we should move compaction to staggered per-cluster windows and add IO headroom on nvme (or move wal to separate device). also consider adding leaseDuration bump on controller-manager to tolerate short stalls
samir: agree on staggered compactions and WAL separation. for the immediate incident can we also bump controller-manager leader-elect leaseRenewDeadline from 500ms -> 1500ms? fewer flips in the short term
liz: can do a canary bump on non-prod first, then prod if stable. kicking off canary in staging now
samir: timeline check?
liz: compaction rollback is applied, nvme io already trending down. SNAT offload in flight. canary leader-duration in staging started. will monitor for 20m then escalate
dena: SNAT offload complete, egress errors down, but still watching conntrack tail
jules: thanks all — looks like we have a good mitigation runway. follow-ups: ops runbook update for compaction changes, add preflight IO check, add gating on compaction schedule changes
liz: agreed. filing follow-up ticket and postmortem if we see recurrence. closing this thread if stable in 30m :thumbsup:
